candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory reservation failures (503) and cascading order/checkout 502s across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server metrics, saturation, connection pool) not observed; root cause of the redis timeouts is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts with DependencyUnavailable, propagating to inventory 503 and order/checkout 502s; gateway logs and metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with ~2s durations. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying redis cause unverified.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs showing latency, saturation, or connection pool state during the incident window
